prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A tall, sleek aluminum can stands upright at the center of the composition, its surface gleaming with a metallic golden hue. The can is branded with the iconic white Coca-Cola script, but beneath it, the word "BUZZ" appears in bold, modern lettering. A realistic illustration of a bee, detailed with delicate wings and fine body hairs, is prominently featured below the text, hovering above a subtle honeycomb pattern that fades into the background of the can. Droplets of condensation and scattered beads of water glisten on the reflective surface around the base, suggesting the can is cold and freshly served. The background is a rich, luminous gold, softly blurred with bokeh light effects that create a dreamy, celebratory atmosphere. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the can’s curves and metallic finish, while the shallow depth of field keeps the focus sharply on the product, lending a polished, commercial quality to the image. The overall style is vibrant and inviting, with a playful yet sophisticated mood, reminiscent of high-end beverage advertising photography.
